meta.description: France NPK recommendations for 11 crops - user-supplied data (2026-10-13) with French research sources (ARVALIS, Terres Inovia, ITB, COMIFER). All source values already per-hectare.

records.applicationTiming: 3 splits: tillering start, stem elongation (Z30), flag leaf (Z39).
records.applicationMethod: COMIFER balance-sheet method (Methode du bilan previsionnel). N split into 3 doses: 40-50 kg at tillering start, 80-100 kg at stem elongation (Z30), 40-60 kg at flag leaf (Z39). P2O5 and K2O applied basally.
records.notes: N 160-220, P2O5 50-70, K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Soft wheat (ble tendre), 7.5-9 t/ha target.
records.source_org_2: COMIFER (Comite Francais d'Etude et de Developpement de la Fertilisation Raisonnee)

records.applicationMethod: N split into 2 doses at tillering and stem elongation. P2O5 and K2O applied basally.
records.notes: N 120-160, P2O5 45-65, K2O 60-85 kg/ha. Winter barley (orge d'hiver); spring malting lower.

records.applicationTiming: Starter at planting; main N side-dressed at 6-8 leaf stage.
records.applicationMethod: Starter localized N-P band at planting; main nitrogen side-dressed at 6-8 leaf stage. P2O5 and K2O basally.
records.notes: N 150-200, P2O5 60-80, K2O 80-120 kg/ha. Grain maize (mais grain).

records.applicationTiming: Split at regrowth stage (reprise de vegetation): 2 spring doses.
records.applicationMethod: N applied at regrowth split into 2 spring doses. P2O5, K2O and sulphur basally before regrowth.
records.notes: N 140-180, P2O5 50-70, K2O 80-120 kg/ha. Winter rapeseed (colza d'hiver).

records.applicationMethod: All fertilizer applied entirely before sowing. Excess N promotes lodging and Phomopsis - do not exceed.

records.micronutrients: Seed inoculation with Bradyrhizobium required (no N fertilizer needed).
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O incorporated pre-plant. No mineral nitrogen applied - crop relies on biological N-fixation via Bradyrhizobium.

records.applicationTiming: P/K autumn-winter; N 10-15 days before sowing or split at 2-4 leaves.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O applied in autumn/winter. N applied 10-15 days before sowing or split at 2-4 leaf stage.
records.notes: N 100-130, P2O5 50-70, K2O 140-200 kg/ha. Sugar beet (betterave sucriere).

records.applicationTiming: Basal bed application (full P/K, 50% N); 50% N at tuber initiation/ridging.
records.applicationMethod: Full P2O5 and K2O plus 50% N applied in the planting bed; remaining 50% N at tuber initiation/ridging.
records.notes: N 130-180, P2O5 80-120, K2O 180-260 kg/ha. Potato (pomme de terre).

records.applicationTiming: Early spring top-dress at vegetation restart.
records.applicationMethod: P2O5 and K2O basally; N top-dressed in early spring at vegetation restart.

records.applicationTiming: 4 splits: tillering, stem elongation, heading, flowering.
records.applicationMethod: N split into 4 doses: tillering, stem elongation, heading, flowering. High late-split N crucial for 14%+ protein and vitrosity. P2O5 and K2O basally.
records.notes: N 170-220, P2O5 55-75, K2O 60-90 kg/ha. Durum wheat (ble dur).

records.applicationTiming: 1/3 at sowing; 2/3 side-dressed at 4-6 leaf stage.
records.applicationMethod: One-third of N plus all P2O5 and K2O at sowing; remaining two-thirds N side-dressed at 4-6 leaf stage.
records.notes: N 80-120, P2O5 45-60, K2O 50-80 kg/ha. Grain sorghum (sorgho grain).
